name: tinycast-composer
title: Composer
description: Rewrite or draft emails with Claude Code, using the Outlook recipients, subject and thread for tone.
author: tehss1

commands.name: compose
commands.title: Compose with Claude
commands.subtitle: Composer
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text, or draft at the caret, using the Outlook email for context.

commands.name: history
commands.title: Composer History
commands.subtitle: Composer
commands.description: Browse the last seven days of Composer conversations.

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Claude model for new drafts. Change it per conversation with ⌘⇧M.

preferences.name: effort
preferences.title: Reasoning Effort
preferences.description: Passed to claude --effort. Default leaves it to Claude Code.

preferences.name: internalDomains
preferences.title: Internal Email Domains
preferences.description: Comma-separated domains. When every recipient is on one, Composer uses the relaxed internal tone.

preferences.name: readOutlookContext
preferences.title: Outlook
preferences.label: Read recipients, subject and thread from Outlook
preferences.description: Uses Tinycast's Accessibility access. The quoted thread is never saved.

preferences.name: style
preferences.title: Writing Style
preferences.description: Replaces the default style instruction. Leave blank for short, one-thought-per-paragraph emails.

preferences.name: claudePath
preferences.title: Claude Code Path
preferences.description: Leave blank to find claude in ~/.local/bin, Homebrew and other common places.
